zhvi.source: Zillow Home Value Index, state, smoothed & seasonally adjusted

zori.source: Zillow Observed Rent Index, county file chain-linked to a state index with ACS 2023 renter-household weights

caveats.zori_note: Zillow publishes no state rent index. These are county ZORI series aggregated to states with ACS 2023 renter-household weights. Zillow's county panel grows over time, so the index is chain-linked: each month's change uses only counties present in both that month and the previous one, and the level is rebased to the latest month's actual weighted dollar rent. Without that step, counties entering the sample would show up as rent growth. The share of each state's renters covered in the latest month is in the table.
caveats.trend_note: Every trend is a log-linear fit on that state's own 2000–2019 annual values. Rents (ZORI) begin in 2015, so their trend is fit on 2015–2019 only and is marked as a short window.
